description: facebookAdLibrary: Company Ads. GET /v1/facebook/adLibrary/company/ads. Provide one of: pageId, companyName. A company's ads from its Ad Library page, with the same filters as ad search. Returns results and a cursor. An empty page costs 0 credits, and an unknown companyName is a 404 at 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when results is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

companyName.description: Company name, resolved to its Ad Library page (exact name first, else the top match). Provide companyName or pageId.

country.description: Where Facebook showed the ad: one two-letter country code, such as US, or ALL (default). Results can include advertisers from other countries whose ads reached it.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page. Send it with the same filters.

end_date.description: Only ads with impressions on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: Only ads in this language: a two-letter code such as EN, ES or FR.

media_type.description: Ad media type. Defaults to ALL. MEME means an image with text.

pageId.description: Ad Library page id, from /v1/facebook/adLibrary/search/companies. Provide pageId or companyName.

sort_by.description: Sort by impressions (high to low), or Most Recent (relevancy_monthly_grouped). Defaults to impressions.

start_date.description: Only ads with impressions on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: Status of the ad. Defaults to ACTIVE.

name: facebook_adLibrary_company_ads
